description:
We're   looking   for   an   engineer   who   enjoys   variety .   In   this   role   you'll   work   on   deployments , CI/CD,   automation ,   troubleshooting   production   issues ,   product   configuration ,   and   scripting .   No   two   days   are   the   same ,   so   adaptability   and   a   willingness   to   learn   are   essential .   

   
 

 Day   in   the   Life   of   the   Software Engineer (DevOps) :   

 Collaborates with Product Development, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams to support the design and delivery of cloud solutions for enterprise applications.   

 
 Contributes to the development and enhancement of cloud-native capabilities that improve   the scalability , resilience, and delivery of products.   

 
 Develops, tests, and   maintains   automation tooling, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud delivery processes, with guidance from more experienced team members.   

 
 Works with containerization technologies, Kubernetes, and Helm to deploy and support platform capabilities.   

 
 Assists   development teams in adopting cloud and DevOps practices and using the platform effectively.   

 
 Supports the implementation and maintenance of monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions for applications, infrastructure, and shared services.   

 
 Investigates   operational issues, contributes to troubleshooting activities, and escalates complex matters when   appropriate .   

 
 Learns   about new tools, technologies, and cloud-native patterns and   shares   relevant findings with the team.   

 
 Works within a Scrum/Agile environment, contributes to the DevOps backlog, and   participates   in sprint ceremonies.   

 
 Collaborates with cross-functional teams to follow and continuously improve deployment and operational practices.   

 
   
 

 Required   Qualifications   -   About   you :   

 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science , Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.   

 
 Foundational experience working with Linux environments and writing basic Bash scripts.   

 
 Familiarity with automation or scripting using Bash and/or Python.   

 
 Basic knowledge of at least one cloud platform, such as AWS or Azure.   

 
 Familiarity with containerization technologies, such as Docker, and an understanding of container orchestration concepts.   

 
 Exposure to CI/CD concepts and tools, such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.   

 
 Experience using Git and familiarity with modern software development workflows.   

 
 Basic understanding of monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting concepts.   Exposure to   tools such as Prometheus, Grafana,   Graylog , or Loki is an advantage.   

 
 Understanding of   networking fundamentals, including DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, and SSH.   

 
 Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to seek guidance and escalate complex issues when   appropriate .   

 
 Ability to contribute across automation, deployments , operations, and application support activities.   

 
 Responsible   and proactive approach to assigned work, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks.   

 
 Good   communication   and collaboration skills.   

 
 Strong interest in learning   new technologies   and developing   expertise   in complex business domains.   

 

     
 

 Highly   Preferred :   

 Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.   

 
 Exposure to Kubernetes and Helm.   

 
 Familiarity with incident response and production support processes.   

 
 Exposure   to secrets   management solutions, such as AWS Secrets Manager or Azure Key Vault.   

 
 Familiarity with messaging platforms, such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.   

 
 Basic understanding of security best practices and vulnerability management.   

 
   
 

 AI   Fluency   &   Growth   Mindset -   We   welcome   candidates   who :   


 Understand   core   AI   concepts   and   apply   them   ethically   to   enhance   productivity ,   insights ,   and   decision-making .   

 
 Craft   effective   prompts   to   optimize   the   quality   and   relevance   of   AI- generated   outputs .   

 
 Explore   and   apply   agentic   AI   systems ,   using   or   managing   autonomous   agents   to   streamline   workflows   and   automate   tasks .   

 
 Leverage   AI   tools   to   boost   efficiency ,   creativity ,   and   innovation   in   their   daily   work .   

 
 Stay   curious   and   adaptable ,   continuously   experimenting   with   AI- driven   solutions   to   elevate   team   performance   and   customer   impact .   

 
   

   


 Why Join PROS? 
  
 PROS culture and its extraordinary people are at the core of our success. We are passionate about what we do and relentless in delivering on our promises.
  
 Our commitment to customer success inspires us to think smarter and dream bigger, empowering airlines to achieve more than they ever imagined through intelligent offer and revenue optimization.
  
 At PROS, we foster a culture of care, where people feel supported to grow, innovate, and bring their best selves to work—every day. From flexible ways of working to continuous learning, we empower our teams to thrive both personally and professionally.
  
 Join PROS, a dedicated travel technology company with nearly 40 years of proven airline expertise and a long runway for future growth, now powering the future of AI-driven airline retailing. If you want to be part of something exceptional, help us shape how airlines compete, innovate, and win.
 
 
 PROS Core Values 
 We are Owners 

 We look for every opportunity to create a better PROS and a better experience for our customers – and we hold ourselves accountable.
 
 We are Innovators 

 We think creatively to find new paths to success – for our people, our customers and our business.
 
 We Care 

 We are centered on caring for the people, businesses, and communities we serve.
